**AuditService depends directly on UserService for identity resolution.** Audit records contain the resolved user rather than the raw token. [audit-service#Integrations]

The components involved are:

| Component | Role |
|---|---|
| **AuditService** | Records the resolved user in each audit record. |
| **UserService** | Resolves identity and validates session tokens forwarded by the gateway. |
| **UsersAPI** | The API exposed by UserService. The documentation establishes a service dependency but does not explicitly identify an AuditService → UsersAPI call. |
| **UsersPostgresDatabase** | Stores UserService’s user records. Soft-deleted users retain their rows with a deletion timestamp so audit records can still resolve them. |
| **`ORDER_DB_URL`** | Configures UserService’s read replica; its historical name is retained because three deployment scripts read it. |

Thus, the identity-resolution dependency chain is **AuditService → UserService → UsersPostgresDatabase**, with **`ORDER_DB_URL`** configuring UserService’s read replica. [user-service#Overview; user-service#Data; user-service#Configuration]
